title.zh: Does becoming a federal bank protect crypto from Washington—or give Washington more control?
title.en: Does becoming a federal bank protect crypto from Washington—or give Washington more control?

current_state.zh: Crypto firms are increasingly seeking federal trust bank charters to gain legal custody frameworks and protection from political pressure, but this also subjects them to direct OCC supervision and potential future regulatory constraints.
